title: How to migrate a Jest suite to Node's test runner
problem: Jest pulls a framework, a transformer and a reporter stack into a project whose runtime already ships a test runner, but rewriting thousands of Jest-style tests into node:test calls is not an option.
outcome: The same suite running on node:test through @hyperfrontend/testing, with its describe blocks, matchers, mocks and jest.mock declarations unchanged, the same test count as the Jest baseline, coverage at or above it, and Jest uninstalled.

knowledge: A suite that runs green under Jest today, with its test count and coverage table recorded
Node.js 22.18 or later on every machine that runs the tests
No snapshot tests and no custom matchers registered through expect.extend
